title: My Husband’s Ex Said Her 7-Year-Old Son Was Actually His—So I Sent Her Husband the Same Message
excerpt: I was drinking coffee in my kitchen in Austin, Texas, still wearing my fuzzy slippers, when an iMessage flashed across Jason’s phone.His face changed instantly....
author: Admin

blocks.text: I was drinking coffee in my kitchen in Austin, Texas, still wearing my fuzzy slippers, when an iMessage flashed across Jason’s phone.
It was as if someone had reached inside his chest and pulled the life out of him.
The name glowing on the screen was Ashley.
Ashley: Jason, I can’t keep this from you anymore. Caleb is your son.
At least, I believed that he believed what he was saying.
Ashley had been gone from Jason’s life for almost eight years.
So why suddenly tell him that her seven-year-old son was his?
Ashley: He has your eyes. I’ve always known.
Because the whole thing was so cruel that my mind didn’t know what else to do.
I asked Jason whether he had ever slept with Ashley around the time Caleb was conceived.
That hesitation hurt more than the message.
The Woman Behind the Message
Ashley, Daniel, and Caleb standing beside Christmas trees.
At least, that’s what social media suggested.
There were almost no pictures of Ashley and Caleb’s birth.
“Have you told Ashley you want a DNA test?”
Because if she genuinely wanted Jason to know the truth, why would she object to proof?
“Jason, I never wanted to tell you this.”
“You just sent him a message saying he has a seven-year-old son.”
Then she said something that made my stomach tighten.
Finally, I said the only thing that came to mind.
The Message
I found Daniel’s number through an old business listing Ashley had tagged in.
I stared at the blank message box for nearly a minute.
Daniel, I think you deserve to know something. Ashley contacted my husband today and told him that her seven-year-old son is actually his.
His voice was completely different from Ashley’s.
“Because Ashley told me Caleb was mine.”
“She told me Caleb was my son. She showed me the hospital paperwork. She told me she’d been faithful.”
“Because I recently asked for a DNA test.”
Ashley wasn’t confessing because she wanted Jason.
She was confessing because she was afraid.
The DNA Test
Daniel explained that Caleb had recently needed medical testing.
The doctors had asked about family medical history.
A genetic specialist had recommended additional testing.
He asked Ashley to take a paternity test.
Then, three days before she contacted Jason, Daniel told her he had secretly ordered a legal DNA test for himself and Caleb.
The results were due the following week.
She wanted him to believe Caleb was his before Daniel discovered the real answer.
But there was one thing Ashley hadn’t counted on.
Daniel had already received a partial genetic report.
And it showed that Daniel was not Caleb’s biological father.
“Caleb’s blood type doesn’t match either of us.”
I could see the fear returning to his face.
“Then where did the child come from?” I asked.
The Truth Comes Out
She sat across from us and started crying before anyone said anything.
She explained that eight years earlier, she had been in a terrible situation.
She had been dating Daniel but had secretly been seeing other people.
She never knew which man was the father.
Years later, she realized she might have been wrong.
But instead of telling the truth, she buried it.
She contacted Jason because he was the only other man she could identify from that period.
She hoped he would accept responsibility.
The Photograph
As we were leaving, Jason suddenly remembered something.
It was a picture of Caleb standing beside a birthday cake.
He looked at the date attached to the photo.
